parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter on your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the service instance.

Call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to obtain the service instance ID.
